arabic_html:
فَسَتَذْكُرُونَ مَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ ۚ
وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ ۞
translation: And you will remember what I now say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allah. Indeed, Allah is Seeing of His servants.
explanation_html: The believer's release — 'I entrust my affair to Allah.' Ibn Kathīr renders it: my affair I leave to Allah. You act, then you hand the outcome to the One who sees all.
explanation_vo: The believer's release — 'I entrust my affair to Allah.' Ibn Kathir renders it: my affair I leave to Allah. You act, then you hand the outcome to the One who sees all.
